asan_ubsan_note: Atheris ships its own coverage instrumentation; ASan/UBSan are OS-level and require the runtime to be enabled. The harness itself is compatible with ASan/UBSan-enabled CPython (atheris loads natively under them); whether they catch issues depends on the CPython build, not the harness.
